instruction: do the accessiblity check wgha 2.2 standard and after fixing issues and adding that skill to the package you may consider std 09 and 13 done

criterionAmendment.subject: STD-13
criterionAmendment.before: Record keyboard activation, traversal, focus restoration and actual screen-reader output, including remaining limitations.
criterionAmendment.after: Record scoped WCAG 2.2 A/AA review, repair discovered issues, verify keyboard/semantic/reflow behavior and distribute the accessibility skill; disclose unperformed actual assistive-technology and native zoom checks.

interpretation: Owner explicitly permits closing STD-09 and STD-13 after the stated conditions. This amends the original actual-speech gate for this bounded package, without asserting that speech was tested or claiming full WCAG conformance.
